records.text: An anonymous family friend of Kolvet told Owens that Kolvet had said he lost out on millions when Kirk said no.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep X3VKJVJ7cN4)

appearances.snippet: And then it was confirmed from a family friend of Andrew Kolvet who wrote me and said that Andrew said that he lost out on millions when Charlie said no.

verification.notes: The alleged family friend is anonymous and the private message has not been published or authenticated. Kolvet denied the underlying millions claim, and no independent evidence resolves the dispute.
